svg.aria-label: Kimchi Premium ETL pipeline in three stages. Ingestion: a cron job triggers a scraper that pulls headlines from news sources. Processing: a webhook enqueues one BullMQ job per headline, an LLM summarizes it and a second pass translates it to Korean. Delivery: the Korean version goes to Telegram, both languages go to Sanity CMS, and the Astro site reads from Sanity.
